title: Daily Workout · November 5
note: 5K progression: 6 × 90-second jogs, upper body, glutes, abs and obliques. Test New Balance 1080v15 with thinner Skechers socks and unchanged lacing; compare warmth afterward.

items.name: Lying quad stretch
items.instructions: Lie on your side and gently bring heel toward glutes.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit upright with soles together and knees relaxed.

items.name: Seated spinal twist
items.instructions: Rotate gently without forcing your lower back.

items.name: Plow Pose (Halasana)
items.detail: 1 min including gentle entry and exit
items.instructions: Avoid loading neck or forcing position; skip if uncomfortable.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Walk comfortably.

items.name: Jog interval
items.instructions: Jog at conversational pace; shorten to 60 sec if needed.

items.name: Recovery walk
items.instructions: Recover at easy walking pace.

items.name: Dumbbell floor press
items.instructions: Choose a challenging but controlled weight.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: Support one hand on a stable surface and keep back neutral.

items.name: Weighted glute bridges
items.instructions: Squeeze at top for two seconds without arching.

items.name: Dumbbell lateral raises
items.instructions: Use light weights and avoid shrugging.

items.name: Side planks
items.detail: 3 min · 2 × 35 sec each side, with rest
items.instructions: Keep hips elevated and torso aligned.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly, maintaining core stability.

items.name: Suitcase carries
items.instructions: Walk upright holding one dumbbell without leaning.

items.name: Bent-knee leg raises
items.instructions: Lower slowly without arching lower back.
